name: correlate
description: Cross-domain correlation engine that finds shared entities (countries, IPs, actors, tickers) across two or more intelligence domains. Pulls live data from all specified domains and runs entity extraction to identify overlaps. Use this to discover connections between seemingly unrelated events across conflict, market, cyber, weather, military, and health domains.

parameters.domains: array of strings (required, minimum 2) — Domains to correlate. Valid values: conflicts, markets, cyber, weather, military, health
parameters.region: string (optional) — Geographic filter to narrow results (country or region name)

examples.description: Find connections between conflict zones and cyber threats
Correlate military and market activity in the Middle East
Three-way correlation across conflicts, weather, and health
